resources.title: MDN Web Docs: HTML and CSS Basics
CSS-Tricks: A Complete Guide to Flexbox

practice_tasks: Initialize a Git repository and make your first commit on GitHub.
Build a semantic HTML5 personal portfolio page styled with modern CSS.
Implement a responsive layout using CSS Flexbox and Grid that adapts to mobile and desktop screens.
Use Browser Developer Tools to inspect elements, debug CSS layout issues, and test responsiveness.

resources.title: MDN Web Docs: Making HTTP requests using Fetch

practice_tasks: Write ES6+ JavaScript scripts utilizing arrow functions, destructuring, and array methods (map, filter, reduce).
Use console.log and the browser debugger breakpoints to troubleshoot a broken JavaScript function.
Fetch public data from a RESTful API (e.g., GitHub Users API or OpenWeather) and display it in the console.

resources.title: Tailwind CSS Documentation: Installation and Utility Classes

practice_tasks: Create a new React project using Vite.
Build reusable functional components (Header, Card, Footer) styled with Tailwind CSS.
Manage component state using useState and fetch data from a REST API inside a useEffect hook to render a dynamic list.

focus_skills: Basic CI/CD & Deployment (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Actions)
practice_tasks: Migrate key components from Week 3's React project to TypeScript by adding proper interfaces and types.
Implement React Context API to manage a global UI state (e.g., Dark Mode toggle or User Authentication stub).
Deploy your completed React application live onto Vercel and connect your GitHub repository for automatic deployments.
